title: 주식회사 등의 외부감사에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 주식회사 등의 외부감사에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 3 (Composition of the Accounting Standards Committee)
(1) The Accounting Standards Committee (hereinafter referred to as "the Accounting Standards Committee"), consisting of 9 members, including one chairperson, shall be established with consideration of gender balance.
(2) The chairperson shall be the chairperson of the Korean Accounting Standards Foundation (hereinafter referred to as "the Korean Accounting Standards Foundation"), which is established under the "Financial Supervisory Act" and has obtained approval from the Financial Supervisory Commission, in accordance with the "Civil Code."
(3) Eight members of the Accounting Standards Committee shall be appointed by the chairperson of the Korean Accounting Standards Foundation, following the recommendation of the Accounting Standards Committee Candidate Nomination Committee, and subject to the approval of the Korean Accounting Standards Foundation's board of directors. One of these eight members shall be appointed as a permanent member by the chairperson of the Korean Accounting Standards Foundation upon approval by the Korean Accounting Standards Foundation's general meeting.
(4) The Accounting Standards Committee Candidate Nomination Committee shall be composed of 9 members, including those recommended by the following:
1. The Chairman of the Korean Chamber of Commerce and Industry (hereinafter referred to as "the Korean Chamber of Commerce and Industry"), established under Article 34 of the "Korean Chamber of Commerce and Industry Act."
2. A member of the Financial Supervisory Commission

President of the Korea Securities & Exchange Commission (hereinafter referred to as "KSE), established under the relevant laws and regulations.
President of the National Bank Association, established under the "Civil Code" and obtained a license from the Financial Services Commission.
President of the Korea Securities Finance Corporation, established under the "Act on Securities and Financial Investment."
President of the Korean Institute of Certified Public Accountants.
Director of the Financial Supervisory Service (hereinafter referred to as "FSS"), established under Article 24 of the "Act on the Establishment of the Financial Services Commission."
Chairman of the Stock Exchange (hereinafter referred to as "Stock Exchange"), licensed by the Financial Services Commission under Article 373-2 of the "Act on Securities and Financial Investment."
President of the Korea Accounting Association, established under the "Civil Code" and obtained a license from the Financial Services Commission.
Director of the Korean Accounting Standards Institute.
The Committee for Nominating Candidates for the Accounting Standards Committee shall appoint individuals who meet the following criteria, within twice the number of individuals nominated:

The following qualifications are recommended:

1. An individual who holds a recognized accounting license and has at least 10 years of practical experience in related work after obtaining the license.
2. An individual who holds a master's degree or higher in finance or accounting and meets one of the following criteria:
    a. A researcher at a recognized research institution in the field of finance or accounting with at least 10 years of work experience.
    b. An individual employed as an assistant professor or higher at a university (including corresponding foreign universities, referred to as "university" hereafter) and has at least 10 years of work experience teaching finance or accounting.
3. An individual who has worked as an executive in a publicly listed company (as defined in Article 9(15)(3) of the "Act on Capital and Financial Investment") or a financial institution subject to examination under Article 38 of the "Act on the Establishment of the Financial Supervisory Service" for at least 10 years in the field of finance or accounting.

1. Individuals with more than 15 years of experience as an employee.
2. Individuals with more than 10 years of experience in financial or accounting-related work or supervision at national, local government, public institutions, the Financial Supervisory Service, stock exchanges, or financial investment-related institutions as defined in Article 9(17) of the "Act on the Management of Public Institutions," excluding those specified in item 8 of the same article.
⑥ The following individuals are ineligible to serve as a member: <amended December 17, 2019>
1. A person under legal guardianship.
2. A person who has been declared bankrupt and has not been discharged.
3. A person who has been sentenced to imprisonment of more than five years, or whose sentence has been completed (including cases where completion of sentence is considered), or whose sentence has been suspended for more than 5 years from the date of completion of sentence.
4. A person who has been sentenced to imprisonment of more than five years and is still under suspension.
5. A person who has been sentenced to a fine or higher penalty under the financial-related regulations as defined in Article 5 of the "Act on the Governance of Financial Institutions" and whose sentence has been

Individuals who have not passed or have had their certification revoked (including those whose certification has been terminated), or who have not been inactive for more than 5 years from the date of revocation or termination.
6. Individuals who have been suspended from their duties (including partial suspensions) pursuant to Article 48 of the "Act on Certified Public Accountants" and are still in that state or have not been inactive for more than 5 years from the date of suspension or revocation.
7. The term of office for the members is 3 years, and they may be re-appointed for one term only. However, even if the term of office expires, they can continue to perform the duties until a successor is appointed.
8. If the chairperson is unable to perform their duties for any reason, a permanent member will perform the duties on their behalf. If both the chairperson and a permanent member are unable to perform their duties for any reason, the duties will be performed in the order of appointment.
9. All other matters related to the organization and operation of the Accounting Standards Committee, except for those specified in paragraphs 1 through 8, shall be determined by the Korean Accounting Standards Institute.
